scope: Current module source grouping, canonical file order and raw original byte fingerprint for production codegen keys.
baselineScope: Virtual CompilationSource metadata, not platform filesystem loading. Case-distinct paths reverse the codegen implementation hash because OrdinalIgnoreCase leaves a stable input-order tie.
decision: Use the existing exact-source generation canonical ordinal UTF16 path order in codegen too. Preserve raw source bytes and each byte-field length/delimiter. Group by full parsed logical namespace, include every file, and retain the complete member list and all-files standard-library classification. Native metadata paths reuse the already qualified codegen identity UTF16 comparator; ordinary sys.text.compareOrdinal is UTF8 byte order and is not a substitute.
csharpFocusedResult: passed5/5 with valid namespace/comment source bytes and direct raw binary field boundary control; input-stable, processes stopped

utf16SourceInspection.stdlib/sys/text.slg:compareOrdinal: Compares UTF8 bytes, so not compatible with CSharp UTF16 ordinal on supplementary scalars. Do not globally change this stdlib API.
utf16SourceInspection.selfhost/llvm/codegen_units.slg:identity: Already qualified UTF16 ordering using strict scalar decoding; reuse it through compareIdentityText for metadata paths.
